subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Utilizar recursos e repertório linguísticos apropriados para informar/comunicar/falar do futuro: planos, previsões, possibilidades e probabilidades.

components.description_pt: Identificar estruturas linguísticas usadas para expressar planos futuros, previsões e possibilidades em inglês
components.description_en: Identify linguistic structures used to express future plans, predictions, and possibilities in English
components.cc_component_description: Apply conditional mood to express possibility or hypothetical situations in writing

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre formas linguísticas usadas para previsões, planos e probabilidades sobre o futuro
components.description_en: Distinguish between linguistic forms used for predictions, plans, and probabilities about the future
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between regular and irregular past tense verb forms in context

components.description_pt: Usar recursos linguísticos apropriados para expressar planos futuros em inglês oral ou escrito
components.description_en: Use appropriate linguistic resources to express future plans in oral or written English
components.cc_component_description: Select appropriate verb tense to express conditions and states in writing

components.description_pt: Usar recursos linguísticos apropriados para expressar previsões e probabilidades sobre eventos futuros em inglês
components.description_en: Use appropriate linguistic resources to express predictions and probabilities about future events in English
components.cc_component_description: Select appropriate verb tense to express conditions and states in writing

cc_matches.description: Use verb tense to convey various times, sequences, states, and conditions.
Form and use the past tense of frequently occurring irregular verbs (e.g., sat, hid, told).

Use verbs in the active and passive voice and in the conditional and subjunctive mood to achieve particular effects (e.g., emphasizing the actor or the action; expressing uncertainty or describing a state contrary to fact).
